accelAddHint: A third-party service you must vet yourself; the address must be https://
accelCompatWarning: Third-party channels may drop headers, lack Range support or rewrite responses: results may be wrong or empty. Compatibility is not guaranteed.
accelDesc: Affects only Release asset downloads; direct connection is used when disabled
accelLeakWarning: Acceleration passes through outside servers: they see the URL and headers. Private content needs tokens; signed URLs expire. Private repos stay direct by default.
accelPrivateRepoDesc: Off means no prompts and no acceleration (token stays on device)
accelPrivateWarnBody: Private-repo files require a token. Once enabled, the token is handed to the acceleration channel, which then requests GitHub on its behalf; the token leaves this device.
accelPrivateWarnPoint1: The channel forwards the token to GitHub verbatim (200 with token / 404 without)
accelPrivateWarnPoint2: The token reaches a third-party server; its retention and use are outside this project's control
accelPrivateWarnPoint3: You can turn this off in Settings at any time; doing so returns to "no acceleration" with no exceptions kept
accelPrivateWarnTitle: Accelerating private repos: your token will leave this device
accelScopesHint: Endpoint support varies; enable per need, rest direct.

dnsCustomHint: Enter resolver IP; optional DoH endpoint. Clear IP to cancel.
